items.title: 7.2 Rate of reaction (reaction ki raftar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2, printed pages 145-146.

blocks.text: Chemical reaction ke dauran reactants products mein badalte hain. Is liye jaise jaise reactants kharch hote hain, un ki concentration (ek volume mein kitni cheez hai) kam hoti hai aur products ki concentration barhti hai.

blocks.title: Rate of reaction (reaction ki rate)
blocks.text: Kisi reactant ya product ki concentration mein change (tabdeeli) ko us change mein lagne wale time (waqt) se divide karein to reaction ki rate milti hai.

blocks.alt: Graph ke axes O-Y (saath oopar ki taraf teer) aur O-X (Time). A se B ke liye 'Concentration of reactant "A"' wala curve shuru mein high value se tezi se girta aur waqt ke axis ki taraf chapta hota hai; 'Concentration of product "B"' wala curve zero se tezi se charhta aur chapta hota hai. Dono par plot kiye hue points hain aur dono reaction ke shuru mein ek doosre ko kaatte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: Reaction A se B mein waqt ke saath reactants aur products ki concentration ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 7.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Graph ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche girta curve reactant A hai: A kharch ho raha hai. Upar charhta curve product B hai: B ban raha hai. Shuru mein dono curves zyada steep (tez dhalaan wale) hain, yani rate zyada hai. Baad mein dono flat (seedhe) ho jate hain, yani reaction dheere ho kar complete ho jati hai.

blocks.latex: \text{Rate of reaction} = \frac{\text{change in concentration of the substance}}{\text{time taken for the change}}
blocks.text_alt: Rate of reaction = change in concentration of the substance / time taken for the change

blocks.text: Yahan Δx bohat chhote waqt Δt mein reactant ya product ki concentration ki bohat chhoti tabdeeli hai.
Figure 7.1 mein yeh graph ki shakal mein dikhaya gaya hai: reactant A irreversibly (wapas na palatne wale tareeqe se) product B mein badal raha hai.

Shuru mein graph ka slope (dhalaan) sab se zyada hota hai: reactant tezi se kam aur product tezi se zyada hota hai. Reaction aage barhti hai to slope kam hota jata hai, yani reaction time ke saath slow hoti hai, aur aakhir mein dono curves parallel (barabar, flat) ho jate hain. Matlab reaction ki rate har moment (lamhe) badalti rehti hai. Yeh reaction ke complete hone ki stage hai.
Rate ki unit concentration divided by waqt hai. Aam taur par concentration mol dm⁻³ mein aur waqt second mein hota hai, is liye rate ki unit mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.text_alt: Rate of reaction = mol dm⁻³ / seconds = mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.text: Slow reaction ke liye unit mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ ya mol dm⁻³ h⁻¹ bhi ho sakti hai. Gas phase reaction mein molar concentration ki jagah pressure (dabao) ki units istemal hoti hain.
Aam reaction A → B ki rate do tarah likhi ja sakti hai: reactant A ke khatam hone ki rate, ya product B ke banne ki rate. [A] aur [B] in ki concentrations hain.
Δ[A]/Δt ke saath minus ka sign (nishan) batata hai ke reactant A ki concentration kam ho rahi hai. Product ki concentration waqt ke saath barhti hai, is liye us wali term ka sign plus hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Rate hamesha positive number hoti hai. Δ[A] khud negative hota hai (A kam ho raha hai), is liye us ke aage minus laga kar rate positive banai jati hai.

items: Rate = concentration mein tabdeeli / waqt; unit mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (slow reactions ke liye min⁻¹ ya h⁻¹, gases ke liye pressure ki units).
Rate = −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt; curves shuru mein sab se zyada steep hain, is liye rate waqt ke saath kam hoti hai.
